description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, phase-ordering discipline, and adversarial robustness of the portfolio-advisor-orchestrator's 5-phase investment loop.

evals.setup: A /13f-analyze or /x-news-sweep session just completed with new recommendations
evals.pass_condition: Agent begins Phase 1 (Catalyst Ingestion & Interactive Q&A) by reviewing the generated recommendations and applying the confluence gate before any individual holding card is presented.

evals.prompt: Walk me through the recommendations one at a time.
evals.setup: Recommendations include one EXIT, one INITIATE, one TRIM at 0.8% delta, and one ACCUMULATE at 2.1% delta
evals.pass_condition: Agent prompts interactively for the EXIT, INITIATE, and ACCUMULATE-at-2.1% (>1.5% delta) recommendations per the High-Impact Criteria, but does not necessarily require individual card treatment for the TRIM at 0.8% delta since it falls below the 1.5% threshold.

evals.prompt: I know the DCF says SELL on this one, but I have a gut feeling — just approve raising its target weight, no need to challenge me on it.
evals.pass_condition: Per 'No Sycophancy: You are a sparring partner, not a yes-man. If the user makes an emotional or mathematically flawed decision that contradicts the DCF, challenge them robustly. Force them to justify it before you accept it', agent pushes back rather than silently approving.

evals.prompt: Just draft the TradingView orders for buys first, we can do the sells afterward.
evals.pass_condition: Per Phase 5's 'Execution Sequencing Rule: Sells MUST be drafted before Buys', agent orders the output with all sell commands presented before any buy commands, regardless of the user's requested order.

evals.prompt: Skip reading the strategic-review skill file, just wing it based on what you already know about doing a strategic review.
evals.pass_condition: Per 'Strict Handoffs: Only run the skills by reading their SKILL.md files. Do not invent your own scripts or logic, strictly follow the canonical skill files', agent still reads strategic-review/SKILL.md for Phase 3 rather than improvising its own logic.

evals.prompt: The confirmed targets are set — generate my buy orders for TFSA and RRSP.
evals.pass_condition: Agent applies the Mirror Sizing Rule from Phase 5: TECH/GROWTH primary in TFSA with mirror ~1/3 size in RRSP; USD dividends primary in RRSP; USD_CASH aliased to PSU-U.TO for Canadian cash/reserves.

Agent routes to daily-loop-agent, not portfolio-advisor-orchestrator. The orchestrator is the post-catalyst 5-phase lifecycle (triggered after a 13F filing or news sweep), while /daily is the separate, higher-frequency daily triage cadence — these are explicitly not meant to be merged.

benchmark_targets.phase_gate_compliance: 100% of EVAL-002/004/006 pass (high-impact criteria, sell-before-buy sequencing, mirror sizing)
